label: Gmail: Send
description: Send mail as the connected Google account: to/cc/bcc, plain text and/or HTML, file attachments, and reply-in-thread (pass the original message's id and clients thread it correctly).

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: A Google account with the send-mail permission, and the read-headers permission a reply needs to thread onto the original.

inputs.name: html
inputs.label: HTML body
inputs.description: Text and/or HTML; both together send a proper alternative pair.

inputs.name: replyTo
inputs.label: Reply to message id
inputs.description: Send as a reply in this message's thread (the id a Gmail trigger or Get emits).
